newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Comalco at full Bell Bay capacity soon.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Comalco at full Bell Bay capacity soon.

text.p: MELBOURNE, Aug 26 (Ruetr) - Comalco Ltd said on Monday that it expected its Bell Bay aluminium smelter in Tasmania state to reach full capacity within the next two weeks.
"We are progressively restarting idle capacity at the Bell Bay smelter...and we expect it to produce about 119,000 tonnes of aluminium this year," chief executive Terry Palmer said in a statement.
In 1997, the smelter would be capable of producing almost 140,000 tonnes per year, he said.
"We expect it to reach full capacity in the next couple of weeks," he later told a news conference.

The Bell Bay smelter had been operating about 28,000 tonnes a year below capacity since February 1994 when Comalco shut down one of three potlines as part of an international production cutting arrangement to reduce a global supply overhang.
The arrangement expired earlier this year.
In 1995, Bell Bay produced 97,244 tonnes of primary aluminium.
Comalco earlier announced a 48 percent drop in net profit on a joint venture basis to A$50.6 million for the six months to June 30. -- Melbourne bureau 61-3 9286-1421
